title: Generate Transaction Statement Request
description: Generates a period-based PDF or CSV statement, pins it to IPFS and returns the reference (CID, ipfs:// URI and HTTPS gateway URL) with a summary. The CID is only returned after the upload is verified. Costs 0.01 USDT via x402 when called by an agent or API client; free inside the OnFRA app.
